description_full: Freshpet, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, distributes, and markets natural fresh meals and treats for dogs and cats in the United States, Canada, and Europe. It offers dog food, cat food, and dog treats under the Freshpet brand name; and fresh treats under the Dognation and Dog Joy brand names. The company sells its products through a network of company-owned branded refrigerators, the Freshpet Fridges, as well as through various classes of retail, including grocery, mass, club, pet specialty, and international, as well as digital. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Bedminster, New Jersey.

financial_summary: Freshpet, Inc. is a mid-cap consumer defensive business with a $3.1B market cap on $1.1B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +23% over the past three years and +25% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at -4% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 44%.

The business throws off $12M in free cash flow — roughly 1 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.15× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 5.4×.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 2.2% of the shares.
